briefings.title: Former Google CEO Eric Schmidt: The Road to Superintelligence

people.name: Christine Anderson
people.role: Global Head of Corporate Affairs, Blackstone

briefings.tldr: Eric Schmidt and Blackstone executives discuss the massive CapEx buildout in AI, power, and data centers, noting that AI is shifting from infrastructure to real-world usage like Meta’s Muse and Anthropic’s scaling portfolio adoption.

briefings.title: Blackstone's Jon Gray on Big Bets, AI, & Staying Skeptical | The CEO Signal
briefings.tldr: Blackstone COO Jon Gray outlines the firm’s strategy of identifying high-conviction "good neighborhoods" like AI infrastructure and private credit, going big with $1.3 trillion in scale, and maintaining rigorous, skeptical internal debate to challenge consensus and avoid falling in love with investments.

briefings.title: The Investor Behind Costco, Starbucks, and Blackstone | Tony James on The a16z Show
briefings.tldr: Wall Street legend Tony James outlines the strategic decisions that drove historic growth at DLJ, Costco, and Blackstone, emphasizing how rigorous investment committee debate, aggressive retail distribution, and disciplined succession planning build enduring financial franchises.
